mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed arc draws the occluded part of the cone’s circular base rim. Right image: The dashed arc draws the occluded part of the cylinder’s lower circular rim.
Rationales: In both images the feature shows the occluded part of the circular rim of a solid. The dashed arc along the rear half of the cone base near O. The dashed rear part of the lower ellipse of the upright cylinder.
